_meta.description: Partial-depth column normalization on a nested column axis (region, then segment). With normalize_level 0 the top-level region is the 100% denominator: every cell under one region, across its segments and both converted rows, sums to 1. Long shape with margins.columns true emits both the leaf _margin=column rows and the partial _margin=column_at_0 rows.
_meta.name: crosstab_partial_column_normalize_level
